items.title: Spatially heterogeneous pathways linking atmospheric dryness to deep soil moisture
items.title_en: Spatially heterogeneous pathways linking atmospheric dryness to deep soil moisture
items.title_zh: 将大气干湿度与深层土壤水分联系起来的空间异质性路径
items.summary_en: Atmospheric vapor pressure deficit (VPD) has intensified under global warming, yet its influence on soil moisture across depths remains unclear. Using multiple global monthly soil moisture datasets spanning the past decades, we combined pairwise and conditional Granger causality analyses to disentangle pathways linking VPD to surface (0–28 cm, surface soil moisture (SSM)) and deep (28–100 cm, deep soil moisture (DSM)) soil moisture. We identify widespread statistical directional dependence from VPD to both SSM and DSM, whereas the reverse relationships from soil moisture to VPD are comparatively weak. Across global land areas, we identified significant VPD–DSM relationships that remained after conditioning on SSM, here termed SSM-independent pathways, which were concentrated mainly in the mid- to high-latitude regions of the Northern Hemisphere and dominated in most forest and savanna ecosystems. Regions with SSM-independent pathways exhibit significantly higher vegetation greenness and evapotranspiration than neighboring SSM-mediated regions. Our findings reveal spatially heterogeneous patterns of land–atmosphere coupling and suggest an important role for vegetation-mediated water use in linking VPD to DSM variability.
items.summary_zh: 在全球变暖背景下，大气水蒸气压缺口（VPD）有所加剧，但其对各深度土壤含水量的影响尚不明确。 我们利用过去几十年间的多套全球月度土壤含水量数据集，结合成对和条件格朗杰因果分析，厘清了VPD与表层（0–28厘米，表层土壤含水量（SSM））及深层（28–100厘米，深层土壤含水量（DSM））土壤含水量之间的关联路径。 我们发现，VPD 对 SSM 和 DSM 均存在广泛的统计性方向性依赖关系，而土壤水分对 VPD 的反向关系则相对较弱。 在全球陆地范围内，我们发现了显著的 VPD–DSM 关系，这些关系在对 SSM 进行条件控制后仍然存在，此处称为“SSM 独立路径”，主要集中于北半球中纬度至高纬度地区，并在大多数森林和稀树草原生态系统中占主导地位。 具有SSM独立路径的区域，其植被绿度和蒸散量均显著高于邻近的SSM介导区域。我们的研究结果揭示了陆地-大气耦合的空间异质性模式，并表明植被介导的水利用在将VPD与DSM变异性联系起来方面发挥着重要作用。

items.title: Uncovering the systems archetypes of sustainability transitions
items.title_en: Uncovering the systems archetypes of sustainability transitions
items.title_zh: 揭示可持续转型的系统原型
items.summary_en: Moving towards sustainable and resilient energy practices is a challenge with profound organisational and behavioural implications. While the importance of systems approaches in transition management is recognised, key principles of systems thinking such as understanding how complex systems behave, and our role within them, are often overlooked. This paper highlights interconnections, feedback mechanisms, and misperceptions shaping transitions at the intersection of business and societal risks. It uses Senge and Meadows’ work on systems archetypes, such as ‘policy resistance’, ‘growth and underinvestment’ or the ‘tragedy of the commons’, as a diagnostic tool to illuminate and anticipate transition bottlenecks. This approach responds to growing calls for more systemic conceptualisations of the multi-system dynamics hindering sustainability transitions. It can enrich understanding across disciplines, complement energy modelling, and spark stakeholder conversations to contribute to collaboration in a world increasingly shaped by conflicting narratives.
items.summary_zh: 向可持续且具有韧性的能源实践转型是一项具有深远组织和行为影响的挑战。尽管系统方法在转型管理中的重要性已得到认可，但系统思维的关键原则——例如理解复杂系统如何运作以及我们在其中的角色——却常常被忽视。 本文重点探讨了在商业与社会风险交汇处，那些塑造转型进程的相互联系、反馈机制以及误解。 本文采用森格（Senge）和梅多斯（Meadows）关于系统原型的研究成果——例如“政策阻力”、“增长与投资不足”或“公地悲剧”——作为诊断工具，以阐明并预判转型瓶颈。 这一方法回应了日益高涨的呼声，即需要对阻碍可持续发展转型的多系统动态进行更具系统性的概念化阐释。它能够丰富跨学科的理解，补充能源建模，并激发利益相关者的对话，从而在日益受到相互冲突的叙事所塑造的世界中促进协作。

items.title: Armed-conflict, extractivism, and environmental degradation: remote sensing and discourse analysis from Kurdish territories
items.title_en: Armed-conflict, extractivism, and environmental degradation: remote sensing and discourse analysis from Kurdish territories
items.title_zh: 武装冲突、资源掠夺与环境退化：基于库尔德地区的遥感技术与话语分析
items.summary_en: Environmental destruction and extractivism are increasingly central to contemporary armed conflicts. Yet scholarship has paid limited attention to how these processes reshape landscapes over time and become embedded within strategies of war, governance, and resource control. This article examines the intersection of armed conflict, extractivism, and environmental change in Kurdish-dominant areas of the Middle East through a comparative study of Afrin in Syria and Şırnak in Turkey between 2017 and 2024. Both regions have experienced intense militarization, environmental destruction, and expanding resource extraction, making them critical cases for understanding war-driven landscape transformation. The study combines satellite-based land-use and land-cover change analysis with qualitative analysis of official state discourse. High-resolution multispectral satellite imagery is used to detect vegetation loss and land-use transitions, while continuous time-series change detection distinguishes persistent transformation from seasonal variation. This analysis is complemented by a systematic examination of public statements, parliamentary records, and official communications to assess how environmental change is narrated and justified. The results reveal substantial and spatially uneven vegetation loss across both cases. In Afrin, tree-crop cover declined by approximately 19.5% at its lowest point, before partially recovering in 2024, indicating a fluctuating trajectory. In Şırnak, vegetation degradation is concentrated in sparsely vegetated zones alongside a more than fourfold expansion of mining areas. Across both regions, approximately 28 000 hectares of vegetation loss were detected. The findings demonstrate that environmental destruction in war operates both as a material process and a strategy of governance, legitimized through intertwined security, moral, and development narratives. By combining satellite-based environmental monitoring with discourse analysis, the study shows how environmental transformation becomes embedded within broader projects of territorial control and resource extraction. The study contributes to debates on political ecology, extractivism, environmental governance, and sustainability in war-affected landscapes.
items.summary_zh: 环境破坏与资源掠夺在当代武装冲突中日益占据核心地位。然而，学术界对这些过程如何随着时间推移重塑地貌，以及如何融入战争、治理和资源控制策略之中，却鲜有关注。 本文通过对2017年至2024年间叙利亚阿夫林和土耳其希尔纳克的比较研究，探讨了中东库尔德人聚居地区中武装冲突、资源掠夺与环境变化之间的交汇点。 这两个地区都经历了激烈的军事化、环境破坏和资源开采的扩大，因此成为理解战争驱动的景观转型的关键案例。本研究将基于卫星的土地利用和土地覆盖变化分析与对国家官方话语的定性分析相结合。 研究利用高分辨率多光谱卫星图像检测植被损失和土地利用转变，同时通过连续时间序列变化检测方法，将持续性转变与季节性变化区分开来。此外，还系统考察了公开声明、议会记录及官方通讯，以评估环境变化是如何被叙述和正当化的。 研究结果显示，这两个案例中都存在大规模且空间分布不均的植被损失。 在阿夫林，树木和农作物覆盖率在最低点时下降了约19.5%，随后于2024年部分恢复，表明其变化轨迹呈波动态势。在希尔纳克，植被退化主要集中在植被稀疏的区域，与此同时，采矿区面积扩大了四倍多。 在两个地区，共检测到约28 000公顷的植被损失。研究结果表明，战争中的环境破坏既是一种物质过程，也是一种治理策略，其合法性源于安全、道德和发展叙事之间的相互交织。通过将基于卫星的环境监测与话语分析相结合，本研究

items.summary_en: If more cities start regulating outdoor lighting, we humans could make the environment better for all living creaturesEvery night, I can turn off the lights in my room – but I can’t do anything about the outdoor lights in the walkway or parking lot that leak through the curtains. Living in Portland, where the night is still illuminated by street lights, porch lights and parking lot glare, I forgot what it actually feels like to sleep in darkness.I was excited when I realized my travels to a residency in south-east Oregon would show me a sky I hadn’t experienced in decades. In the Oregon outback, part of the International Dark Sky Places network, I would be surrounded by 2.5m acres of unpolluted night in every direction. Continue reading...
items.summary_zh: 如果更多城市开始对户外照明进行规范管理，我们人类就能为所有生物创造更美好的环境。每晚，我虽然可以关掉房间里的灯，但对于透过窗帘渗入室内的走道或停车场里的户外灯光，我却无能为力。 生活在波特兰，这里的夜晚依然被路灯、门廊灯和停车场的刺眼光芒照亮，我已经忘记了在完全黑暗中入睡究竟是一种怎样的感受。当我意识到，前往俄勒冈州东南部的驻留项目将让我重见数十年来未曾体验过的夜空时，我感到非常兴奋。 在俄勒冈州的偏远地区——这里是“国际暗夜天空保护区”网络的一部分——我将被四面八方2.5百万英亩未受污染的夜空所环绕。继续阅读……
